notes.title: New game VRNOID
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I wanted to bring a classic retro game into virtual reality. Check out the result 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33706874/39fe16ab7188309e90b5ff840b42543d8e666079.gif[/img]
 
Your goal is to destroy all bricks and enemies. Collect dropped power-ups but make sure not to miss a ball. Swing your hand to hit the ball just like in Air Hockey.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33706874/05223739216baea5fafde9686287ccd3f691fc16.gif[/img]


[h3]Dodge the bullets or return them to enemies[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33706874/edcdbd6b94e9f5fbf9acfb959550f7c090ebf5b2.gif[/img]

Enemies are trying to shoot your VR head, which takes the challenge to a new level. Dodge bullets or reflect them into the enemy.


[h3]In-game level editor and Workshop[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33706874/58821fda0fe124eb3384b0814f625678d62c591b.gif[/img]
Try out your ideas and upload your own levels to the Steam Workshop. Download levels created by other players. Full VR, no need to leave the game or use a mouse.


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1488510/VRNOID/]Try free demo now[/url]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1488510/VRNOID/

notes.title: King of Spiders Update 10.5
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Today I bring to you: a new campaign mode, a new riding unit, and some fixes
 
King of Spiders mode
You can start the Campaign as spider king, no humans only spider as workers. You start with crystal egg as a town center in which you can hire spiders
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33706874/7d870b507be6ad7bd25946d6ff8c570d41ece287.gif[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33706874/f39122d2f74a6ab0e93875751d2c14a9b564f97e.gif[/img]
Endrian Spider appears on the first island. After defeating Ednrian spider you unlock crystal egg building 

New unit Riding SpiderːKingsLoveː
Has more health than other spiders(except endrian spider boss of course) 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33706874/d1e209003f0e39bbaa1605b06e2263da36172a8c.gif[/img]


Increased Difficulty on Campaign Hard mode
Increased reward for collecting mushrooms x2


Finally fixed bug workers-builders don't count like busy workers and the bug when only one worker continue to build the next buildings after the previous building is done
Thanks, 1st1 for remembering me that bug

Wood wall is cheaper to build
Storage s cheaper to build
No need to build the well to build Village anymore(Sandbox mode)
Fixed rotation of workers during construction
Fixed rotation of workers in the collection of resources
Optimized main menu
Improved main menu UI size
Optimized default settings(if you downloaded the game before this update and have problems with fps try: start any mission, go to the settings and turn off all effects)


Recently I created a Steam Developer page
If you want to keep up with the latest news click follow  https://store.steampowered.com/dev/FullmetalDeveloper
 
Thanks everyone for support!   ːKingsHeartː

notes.title: Game Release !
notes.content:
The time has come to finish the Early Access of No King No Kingdom VR. It was an exciting and long path of developmentːKingLaugthː. Since the beginning, the game has improved a lot.ːKingThumbsUpː Your ideas, suggestions, bug reports have helped me to make it better.  Now with great support from players, it is ready to be released.

The final chapter of the campaign is now available!!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31134781/303d215b57fdf1e19be6f317e616ce2be3e3e2e2.png[/img]
 
In the final chapter, you will encounter your sworn enemies, angels and their master. Will the world will be saved or corrupted by the supreme being, depends on you!
You can continue to play with your old saves,  but I recommend to start a new game in order to collect all the game achievements.

Added 38 Achievements

New Start Options in sandbox mode 
Play as a Snake King, Spider King or King of Cyclops  (appropriate achievements are required)
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31134781/da69e135cd7e1f240b61f55771a394a2021c1a98.png[/img]
New Challenge mission "King of Spiders"

Fixes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33706874/20239afe6d2e2562028d0750508df6fb0b4a5e43.jpg[/img]
Fixed global map air wall glitch on the left hand
Add scrolling feature to left hand on the global map
Fixed sandbox territory glitch
Fixed snake servant UI
Fixed movement lag on Oculus left controller
Fixed right Oculus controller rotation
Improved rotation sensitivity

Now it is simpler. Peasants hire cost is reduced 20>10
Wand of the first tree can spawn a food bush
Fire demon artifact deals more damage and doesn’t burn your units
Fireballs of fire staff fly faster
Improved translations
Fixed bug after Alt+Tabbing the game, cursor changes its position
Fixed run speed of heroes and elves 
Fixed sound bug in the cursed graveyard
Fixed bug with stone tower hp bar, which doesn't disappear
Fixed loading screen picture  
Faster main menu loading
Longer time to invasion in sandbox mode

Thanks again to everyone for support!ːKingsHeartː You are the best! ːKingThumbsUpː
If you want to keep up with the latest news check out Discord https://discord.gg/PgeWbW3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33706874/0d85ea8d40a8a46db1f186cef4cdf1ee7155c88b.png[/img]Hello Everyone!

Today I’ve got another update for you

Optimized global map in sandbox mode. Now each hostile base can create only 1 army so the global map will be not overloaded

A super-strong army of undead that protects the gold node has been removed

Carry-weight of Cyclops is increased to 40. Moreover, mining effectiveness is increased by 40%

Spider-workers now have a new farming ability

Spiders can rip fruit very gently, so they can collect 33-44% more units of food from a farm or bush.
For example, a peasant can get from the bush 25 food, and the spider will collect 36

notes.title: Update 9.7
notes.content:
Good evening dear Kings and Queens, today your loyal servant, FullmetalDeveloper, has prepared for you an another exciting update

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33706874/efee22566d571b6ab1fdafdf21478cd3217e222b.png[/img]
Recently riding Dragons have appeared in the Kingdom! For now there are 5 different dragons and each of them has its own peculiarities
Dragons can be found in the Campaign and in the Sandbox Mode.

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/989010373842292060/FE120A399DCAD084D1F46B07E7191BAEC275EEA9/[/img]

Added support for HTC-vive  

At the moment, it still needs improvements, so you have some suggestions or have found some bugs, please write me
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/989010373842315627/BC1E1F61CD41EF86E8F5FA77402F1505697A331E/[/img]

In different locations you can find a hungry wolf and feed it in order to tame 
The icon of wolves is fixed

Extraction of the tree is accelerated x2  
Houses add 4 populations instead of 2

The farm is a bit cheaper
A bug with a unit carrying a box is fixed !!!

Fixed an invisible wall in a simple mission

The healing power of artifacts is now 4 times stronger
[IMG]https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/913543707646921132/AAAD1B95B8D39B8272AC68B1E5228D577DA478BC/ [/IMG]

Cyclops carry 25 resources at a time and extract iron and stone faster by 50%

Eggs of spiders sometimes can be found in deserts and locations with bushes
Fixed a bug of spinach spiders does not create spiders
 
Campaign mode - More resources around the player that makes game more comfortable

Thanks a lot to rllehman416 for finding a big farm bug 
( After loading the big farm creates a large building and crashes the entire game)

Thanks a lot to DexTheLong who pointed me to the bug with the interface that sometimes does not work on the global map 
Unfortunately, I still have not been able to catch this bug, so I added hot keys
So, if someone finds a combination of actions after which the interface on the global map breaks down, please write me!

Thanks a lot to Sneakyjoe for sharing ideas about the balance and reporting about bugs
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TQ-qQpgQvOg
Thank  everybody for support!

notes.title: Update 9.5

The Queen Spider is one of the most dangerous creatures in the No King No Kingdom! She is able to kill Orcs in 2 bites.
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/941716871897778532/10C9F27808E576AC3A78511DEF93C9C46F724AC2/[/img]

notes.title: Update 9.4
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Today I’ve got another update for you, the next chapter of No King No Kingdom VR “The Undead War!” In this chapter, you will fight against the army of the Undead and their King Gaiseric on a new desert island.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33706874/3c26027cf2f33af7302d158b0c92d7d2318ffa7c.png[/img]

This adventure will become available after you defeat the Mage on the flying island.
Note: (If you have already beat the mage, load the save file before you broke the chain.)

After you defeat the Undead King you will be able to build a crypt and create your own army of undead warriors.

A new iconic mount and unit will also be available, a mighty War Elephant!
You can even create your own elephant horde in the Fort for 500 food and 70 gold (each war elephant)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33706874/bfb083ddd4b3002c78589cf30a5627e8b7831328.png[/img]

Lead one of the fiercest forces known to man, the Bone Lord. Wielding two giant swords Bone Lord has the power to destroy a whole army on his own. He can be hired in the Crypt for 50 iron and 100 gold.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33706874/797768e2ec3451b8df2da6294a1f8253b99375cc.png[/img]

On the last page of the Guide, there are instructions on how to make your own custom banner.

Additional Bug Fixes :
Bush Loading Optimization
When Returning to the Frozen Eye Units Will No Longer Be Stuck In The Air.
The Texture of Fallen Rocks 
Optimized Golem Death Particles
Flying Island Won’t Disappear After You Beat the Mage
Fixed Uncontrolled Golem Aggro 
Opening Menu Will No Longer Restore Health
Cyclops Increased Mining Efficiency


For all of you, Vive players No King No Kingdom VR can be played using Revive. So give it a try and let us know your thoughts!

Special Thanks:

Thank you to everyone who has purchased and reviewed King No Kingdom VR. I really appreciate all the support and will continue to bring you amazing content and experiences. 

Special shout out to @ImmersiveG83  for testing the game on Revive. Check out his great video with the link below:
https://youtu.be/owfnns_sq-8

And another shout out to @CasandChary for No King No Kingdom VR’s first live stream.
https://youtu.be/c_ETvyQmCcY
